import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# 1. Transaction amount distribution
axes[0, 0].hist(df['amount'], bins=10, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7, color='skyblue')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction types distribution
transaction_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
axes[0, 1].bar(transaction_counts.index, transaction_counts.values, color=['lightcoral', 'lightgreen', 'lightblue'])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Types Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
for i, v in enumerate(transaction_counts.values):
    axes[0, 1].text(i, v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=11)

# 3. Hour of day distribution
hour_counts = df['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
axes[1, 0].bar(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, color='mediumpurple', alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transactions by Hour of Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
for i, v in enumerate(hour_counts.values):
    axes[1, 0].text(hour_counts.index[i], v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=11)

# 4. Amount by transaction type
transaction_means = df.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].mean()
axes[1, 1].bar(transaction_means.index, transaction_means.values, color=['gold', 'lightcoral', 'lightseagreen'])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Amount by Transaction Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
for i, v in enumerate(transaction_means.values):
    axes[1, 1].text(i, v + 10, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=11)

# Add dataset summary as text
summary_text = f"Dataset Summary:\nTotal Transactions: {len(df)}\nTotal Amount: ${df['amount'].sum():.2f}\nAverage Amount: ${df['amount'].mean():.2f}\nNo Fraud Cases Detected"
fig.text(0.02, 0.98, summary_text, fontsize=11, verticalalignment='top', 
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
